caption: the tribal marble variant - totem masks, jungle tracks and the classic gap-shot law.
about: Karu re-skins the marble-shooter law into a tribal totem world: mask chains wind across jungle tracks and the shooter clears them with the genre's strictest economy - few power balls, no safety nets, every gap shot counted. It is the kind of regional variant the portal era produced quietly and nobody preserved properly.
The pc build is off the current stores, carried by archive routes.
